cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like your approval for opening up the pond edge. Willow roots and a liner are not a happy partnership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shade doesn't patch a liner. I've taken the willow out before it reached the new pond.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You mean you cut it down without asking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. We can replace shade; we can't ask a root to go round a liner. Will you approve the clearance?

reason: Make expert design correction the tool for obtaining approval of completed removal; B legitimate consent objection forces an explicit admission and renewed approval request.
